protocol.body_contract: Each contracted section has one complete reader-facing sentence in either public grammar; numbers/period/trend/citation and claim metadata are checked separately. Free prose outside these sections is unassessed.
protocol.interface_boundary: Authors/reviewers use only opaque tools/observe/call ports, read real immutable submission bytes and exact source versions, and import no evaluator. Measurement alone reads state and evaluates; no evaluation feedback enters the strategy.
protocol.error_attribution: Expected open-issue approval refusal is business_constraint. Deliberate bad body/opinion is injected strategy error. Unexpected exceptions or tool errors are construction failures retained verbatim, not automatically called environment faults.
protocol.repair: withdraw -> local file change -> submit SAME work and requirement, then separately respond and institutional decide. No automatic issue closure on edit or submission.
limits: Synthetic finite metrics and controlled sentence grammar, not open-ended language quality
No universal autonomous professional review claim
Explicit unknown is a successful incomplete report result under this finite contract

hash_semantics.structured_trace_hashes: SHA-256 of canonical JSON serialization defined beside each hash
hash_semantics.content_by_sha256: JSON decoded only after hash checked against exact stored immutable bytes; no reserialization is used as the immutable file hash

omissions: Complete public observations and repeated tool definitions/returns are omitted from this compact archive; their raw reports and canonical trace hashes are retained.
Complete world state, journal and command/event histories are omitted; final-state exact byte hashes, submissions, adoptions, issue relations and relevant maintenance facts are retained.
No model/API/GPU trace exists; this is an actual public-interface program-strategy experiment.
